# Pre-processing of Metadata

## #1 Packages

```{r}
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
```

## #2 Import Data

```{r}
data_annotation <- as.data.frame(read_excel(here("data","raw","Data_annotation_absolute_rodents.xlsx"),guess_max=21474835))

sample_ids <- read.csv(here("results","table_zenodo_mpd_id.csv"), fileEncoding="latin1")
```

## #3 Remove Non-ITP Samples

```{r}
data_annotation=data_annotation[grepl("NewITP",data_annotation[[1]]),]
```

## #4 Add Cohort and Lab Columns

```{r}
n_cols <- ncol(data_annotation)

cohort <- str_split_i(data_annotation[[1]], "_", 5)

labs <- str_split_i(data_annotation[[1]], "_", 6)

data_annotation$Cohort <- cohort
data_annotation$Lab <- labs

data_annotation <- data_annotation[, c(1, n_cols + 1, n_cols + 2, 2:n_cols)]
```

## #5 Change Compound Names

```{r}
interventions=intersect(sample_ids$zenodo_id,data_annotation$Intervention)

for (row in 1:nrow(data_annotation)) {
  if (data_annotation$Intervention[row] %in% interventions) {
    data_annotation$Intervention[row]=
      sample_ids$id[sample_ids$zenodo_id==data_annotation$Intervention[row]]
  } 
}
```

## #6 Export File as .csv

```{r}
write.csv(data_annotation, here("results","table_Zenodo.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
